adjudication.rationale: Looking at line 253-256 in the diff for GoogleCalendarService.ts updateEvent method: `const selectedCalendar = externalCalendarId ? externalCalendarId : event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId;`. When externalCalendarId is falsy (undefined/null), the code falls to the else branch which searches for `cal.externalId === externalCalendarId` - but externalCalendarId is undefined at this point, so no calendar will ever match (unless a calendar has externalId of undefined). This means selectedCalendar will be undefined when no externalCalendarId is provided, causing the Google API call to fail. The same bug exists in deleteEvent at lines 312-315. This is a clear logic error in the diff.
